title: All-Male Precure Stage Play Returns With Colorful Runway! Production in December
content: The official website for Dancing☆Star Precure , the first stage play in Toei Animation 's long-running Precure ( Pretty Cure ) anime franchise , announced a new all-male stage play centered on fashion titled Colorful Runway!
author: ANN

title: Breakout Sports Anime Hit Confirms Release Date for New Movie Sequel – Watch Trailer
content: One of the biggest sports anime hits of the last few years is coming to the big screen with a new movie sequel, and it has confirmed its first release date with a new trailer helping to show it all off.

title: Victoria of Many Faces Season 2, Special Episode Announced
content: Victoria of Many Faces Season 2 and a special episode have been announced. A new visual was also revealed. The first season concluded with nine episodes in total and is available to watch on Crunchyroll and Ani-One Asia. Studio DEEN animated the first season with Nobukage Kimura as director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Black Clover Season 2 Confirms Early Release Date With Big Screen Debut Plans
content: Black Clover Season 2 is finally set to make its return to screens later this Fall, but Crunchyroll is bringing it to the big screen with an early sneek peek that fans are going to want to see in theaters.
author: ComicBook

title: Black Clover Season 2 Gets Early September Screening at Crunchyroll Anime Nights Alongside Firefly Wedding and More
content: Black Clover Season 2 will be among five Fall 2026 anime titles getting an advance theatrical screening as part of Crunchyroll Anime Nights SNEAK PEEK. The new one-night event will take place on September 21 at 7 p.m.

title: 'Tefuda ga Oome no Victoria' Second Season in Production
content: The 9th and final episode of Tefuda ga Oome no Victoria ( Victoria of Many Faces ) ended with an announcement on Wednesday that a new special episode and second season is in production. The official website also revealed an announcement visual (pictured). Produced by Studio Deen , the first season premiered on July 8.
